label_description_epic_only.text: Only an epic carries a description.

project_not_in_workspace.text: This project is not in one of your workspaces.
project_without_primary_label.text: Every task needs a task type, and the project has none. Add a task type to the project first.
sandbox_ended.text: Sandboxes are cleared after a week, with everything in them.
sandbox_full.text: Five people are in it already, as many as a sandbox takes.
